subject: Request: concession for DeltaRelease 2.1 timing impact (ZenithPay)
messages:
From: Maya Gupta <maya@zenithpay.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: ZenithPay Accounts <accounts@zenithpay.com>
Date: 2028-04-08T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Integration delay impact — request for account credit

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the call today. As we discussed, our integration depends on DeltaRelease 2.1 (session-affinity + optimized KV caching) landing before our production cutover on May 1. The engineering blocker you flagged means we will have to run a temporary, higher-cost routing configuration and keep a standby instance for the next two months. That increases our monthly bill by roughly $42k and delays our go‑live.

Given this is a Redwood roadmap timing issue, we are requesting a commercial concession to cover the incremental costs for the next two months (equivalent to ~$84k), or a mutually acceptable credit/discount. We want to finalize procurement this week; any flexibility on your side will determine whether we proceed with the current SOW.

I’ve attached integration logs and a short timeline.

Appreciate a quick response —
Maya

Maya Gupta
Head of Platform Integrations, ZenithPay
maya@zenithpay.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: integration_logs.zip; delta_release_timeline.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-09T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Integration delay impact — request for account credit

Lauren — forwarding ZenithPay's note. They want a timeboxed concession for roadmap timing that affects their go‑live. A few quick facts:
- Committed ARR: $1.2M/year (annualized)
- Current production start targeted May 1; blocked until DeltaRelease 2.1 lands
- Customer is asking ~$84k credit (two months incremental costs)

Can we carve out authority for a provisional concession? If not, who should we escalate to for exec signoff?

Thanks,
Aditya

Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
(650) 555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com; aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-09T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Integration delay impact — request for account credit

Quick product context: DeltaRelease 2.1 includes a change to KV cache invalidation and a session-affinity switch. The team originally targeted mid-April but an unexpected regression in the on-device quant kernel set back the schedule by ~3 weeks. Current ETA: April 25 for canary, May 6 for general rollout if no further regressions.

Questions for commercial:
1) Is the customer blocked entirely, or can they do a degraded go‑live with the temporary routing you mentioned? (Aditya pls confirm)
2) If we provide a credit, do we want it structured as: 
   - timeboxed credit ($84k) vs percentage discount for next N invoices vs usage-based cap?

From product perspective, we can prioritize the canary but need explicit commitment from commercial to accept a short runway for the rollback window.

—Karthik

Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Management — Serving Runtime

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com; aditya_rao@redwood.com; karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-10T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Integration delay impact — request for account credit

Lauren / Aditya — tagging finance. A few notes:
- Precedent: We provided a timeboxed credit for ScoutPay last year (equivalent to 6% ARR for 2 months), approved by Commercial + CFO.
- Approvals needed: VP Commercial (Grace) for concessions > $50k; CFO signoff for > $100k.
- We need proposed structure and legal language if we do a one-off credit vs amendment.

Please confirm proposed amount and whether the credit is refundable or applied against future invoices. Also include whether we want a short SLA amendment (e.g., acceptance criteria once DeltaRelease 2.1 lands).

Monica

Monica Patel
Finance — Revenue Operations

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com; karthik_iyer@redwood.com; monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-10T12:55:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — timeboxed concession for ZenithPay (ZEN-4321)

Grace — requesting quick exec signoff. Summary:
- Customer: ZenithPay (Strategic, annualized $1.2M)
- Ask: One-time credit to hedge incremental integration costs while DeltaRelease 2.1 is late. Customer proposes ~$84k (2 months added cost).
- Proposed Redwood response: Timeboxed credit of $60k applied across next two invoices + an SLA amendment that ties final acceptance to DeltaRelease 2.1 availability (if rollout completes by May 6 we withdraw remaining credit).
- Rationale: Keep a high-value strategic launch on-schedule; mitigates churn risk and preserves long-term ARR. Product will prioritize canary throughput by Apr 25 but risk of a last-minute regression remains.

Monica: finance is on the thread; they indicate VP Commercial approval for >$50k, CFO needed only >$100k.

Request: Can you sign off on the provisional $60k timeboxed credit with the SLA clause? If yes I will draft the amendment and send to customer this morning.

Thanks —
Lauren

Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com; monica_patel@redwood.com; karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-11T07:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — timeboxed concession for ZenithPay (ZEN-4321)

Lauren — approved. Conditions:
1) Credit capped at $60k, applied over the next two invoices.
2) Credit rescinds pro rata if DeltaRelease 2.1 is confirmed in production by May 6.
3) Legal to include a one‑page addendum: timeboxed credit + acceptance criteria + no other future precedence.

Monica, please confirm accounting treatment. Karthik, please send a short note to Engineering to prioritize the canary windows Apr 21–25.

Grace

Grace O'Connor
VP, Commercial

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Maya Gupta <maya@zenithpay.com>; ZenithPay Accounts <accounts@zenithpay.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com; monica_patel@redwood.com; karthik_iyer@redwood.com; grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration delay impact — request for account credit

Hi Maya — thanks again for outlining the impact and for the supporting logs. We value ZenithPay and want to keep you on track for launch.

Redwood will provide a timeboxed concession capped at $60,000, applied over your next two invoices. The concession is conditional: if DeltaRelease 2.1 reaches production by May 6 we will rescind the remaining portion pro rata. We will also provide a short one‑page addendum (legal) that captures the terms and acceptance criteria; Monica from Finance will follow up on billing mechanics.

Aditya will coordinate next steps on the amendment and Karthik's team will prioritize the canary for Apr 21–25.

Would you like us to draft the addendum for signature today?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: integration_logs.zip; delta_release_timeline.pdf
